title: Microfitting: Continual Learning via Cached Test-Time Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.20258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning is a promising approach to specialize language models to an organization's private data. However, current methods exhibit a number of drawbacks including catastrophic forgetting, where new training updates overwrite prior knowledge. We present microfitting, which trains and caches a small adapter for each document. Each adapter is trained once, offline, on synthetic questions targeted at demonstrated base-model shortcomings and reused whenever that document is queried. This method borrows from test-time learning literature and sidesteps the problem of continual learning through parameter isolation, allowing the system to specialize on new data without overwriting prior knowledge. The process that generates adapter training data also improves over time, revising its recipe from previous outcomes and fresh examples of the target workload. On DeepSeek V4 Flash, microfitting substantially improves accuracy over the base

translated_title: 微拟合：通过缓存的测试时训练实现持续学习
translated_abstract: 持续学习是一种将语言模型专门化以适配组织私有数据的有前景的方法。然而，现有方法存在诸多缺陷，包括灾难性遗忘——即新的训练更新会覆盖先前的知识。我们提出了微拟合（microfitting），即为每个文档训练并缓存一个小型适配器。每个适配器仅在离线状态下针对已证实的基座模型缺陷所生成的合成问题训练一次，并在该文档被查询时重复使用。该方法借鉴了测试时学习的相关文献，通过参数隔离规避了持续学习的问题，使系统能够在专门化适配新数据的同时不覆盖先前知识。生成适配器训练数据的过程也会随时间不断改进，根据以往的结果和目标工作负载的新样本来修订其配方。在 DeepSeek V4 Flash 上，微拟合相比基座模型大幅提升了准确率。
tldr: 微拟合通过为每个文档离线训练并缓存一个小型适配器，以参数隔离的方式规避灾难性遗忘，使语言模型能够持续学习新数据而不覆盖旧知识。
en_tdlr: Microfitting trains and caches a small adapter for each document offline, using parameter isolation to sidestep catastrophic forgetting and enable continual learning without overwriting prior knowledge.
